nav.billingHint: Your Housetel plan, usage and invoices.

past_due.title: We couldn't charge your subscription
past_due.owner: You owe {{amount}}. We'll retry the charge over the next days; pay now to avoid a suspension.
past_due.member: A subscription payment is due. Let the account owner know so they can check it.

suspended.title: Your Housetel account is suspended
suspended.owner: Pay {{amount}} and everything works again right away. Until then, only billing and your team are available.
suspended.member: The account is suspended for non-payment. Ask the account owner to pay to reactivate it.
suspended.byTeam: The Housetel team suspended the account. Write to facturacion@housetel.co to reactivate it.

billing.title: Plan & billing
billing.description: Your Housetel plan, what you use, the next charge and your invoices. Every module is included.

plan.included: Everything included: PMS, calendar, channel manager, marketplace, DIAN e-invoicing, messaging and AI. No add-ons.

next.firstCharge: First charge, when your trial ends

usage.title: Plan usage
usage.description: Sellable units (active rooms and beds) and properties of your organization.
usage.overLimit: You're over your plan's limit. Everything keeps working; change plans whenever you like.

pay.pending: The payment of {{number}} is processing; it will be confirmed in a few minutes.
pay.declined: The charge was declined. Check the card or use another one.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.text: You owe {{amount}}. Once you pay, Housetel reactivates right away with all your data.
suspended.noInvoices: The Housetel team suspended it. Write to facturacion@housetel.co to reactivate it.

pastDue.title: Your payment is due
pastDue.text: We couldn't charge {{amount}}. We retry {{days}} days after the first attempt (next: {{next}}); if the last one fails, the account is suspended.

callout.askOwner: Only the account owner can pay.

cancelled.title: Your subscription is cancelled
cancelled.text: To use Housetel again, write to facturacion@housetel.co.

cancelling.title: Your subscription ends on {{date}}
cancelling.text: Until then everything keeps working and there are no more charges.

trial.title_one: {{count}} day left in your free trial
trial.title_other: {{count}} days left in your free trial
trial.withCard: Your plan starts on {{date}} and the first invoice is charged to your card.
trial.noCard: Add a card before {{date}} so Housetel keeps working without interruptions.

changePlan.title: Change plan
changePlan.description: Every plan includes every feature; they differ by number of units and properties.
changePlan.when: From your next invoice ({{date}}) you'll pay {{amount}} + {{rate}} % VAT.
changePlan.whenTrial: You pay nothing during the trial. When it ends, the {{plan}} plan starts.
changePlan.tooSmallUnits_one: Too small: you have {{count}} unit and this plan includes up to {{max}}
changePlan.tooSmallUnits_other: Too small: you have {{count}} units and this plan includes up to {{max}}
changePlan.tooSmallProperties_one: Too small: you have {{count}} property and this plan includes {{max}}
changePlan.tooSmallProperties_other: Too small: you have {{count}} properties and this plan includes {{max}}

cancel.title: Cancel subscription
cancel.text: Your plan stays active until {{date}}; after that there are no more charges and access closes.
cancel.confirmText: You'll keep using Housetel until {{date}}. You can resume it before then.
cancel.done: Subscription cancelled. It stays active until {{date}}.

card.title: Subscription card
card.description: Your plan is charged here every period, along with each month's marketplace commissions.
card.simulatedNote: Test mode: no real charge is made.
card.realNote: Card details go encrypted straight to Wompi; Housetel only keeps the brand and the last 4 digits.
card.acceptTerms: I accept Wompi's terms and conditions.
card.acceptData: I authorize Wompi to process my personal data.

errors.expiry: The card is expired or the date is invalid (MM/YY)
errors.accept: To save the card, accept both Wompi documents.

commissions.title: Commissions
commissions.intro: Every booking that comes from the Housetel marketplace pays a percentage of the lodging, before taxes. It accrues on the check-out date, is settled monthly and invoiced on the 1st.
commissions.emptyText: When a guest books through the marketplace, the commission shows up here.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.emptyText: Every invoice for your plan and marketplace commissions shows up here.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.description: What's left before you can take bookings, computed from your hotel's real data.

assistant.title: Create your rooms with AI
assistant.text: Tell the AI what your hotel is like (or paste your website link) and it proposes room types, rooms and rates: you just review and confirm.
assistant.manual: I'd rather do it by hand

profile.title: Complete the hotel profile
profile.complete: Legal data, contact details and description are complete.

rooms.title: Create room types and rooms
rooms.text: Set up your room types (or dorms with beds) and their numbers.

rates.title: Price every room type
rates.text: VAT, policies and rate plans are ready; only the base price is missing.

payments.title: Turn on online payments
payments.simulated: Payments are in simulated mode: connect your Wompi account to take real payments.
payments.real: Wompi connected: your guests pay by card, PSE or Nequi.

channels.title: Publish your hotel
channels.text: Show up on the Housetel marketplace or connect Booking, Airbnb and other channels.

team.title: Invite your team
team.text: Front desk, housekeeping and accounting, each with their own permissions.

first_booking.title: Create your first booking
first_booking.text: Make a test booking to see the whole flow: calendar, folio and check-in.

signup.headline: Your hotel up and running today.
signup.subhead: Create your account, load your rooms with AI and start taking bookings. No card needed to start.

benefits.included: Everything included: PMS, channel manager, marketplace, DIAN e-invoicing and AI.
benefits.onboarding: Guided setup: the AI builds your rooms and rates.

signup.subtitleHotel: We use this to create your account and suggest a plan.
signup.subtitleAccount: You'll own the account and can invite your team.

fields.rooms: How many rooms or beds do you sell?
fields.roomsHint: Count every private room and every dorm bed. You can change it later.
fields.phoneHint: Optional. To help you with the setup.
fields.terms: I accept the terms of service and the personal data policy (Colombian Law 1581 of 2012).

signup.planHint: At that size your plan is {{plan}} ({{price}}/month + VAT) once the trial ends.

errors.hotelName: Enter your hotel's name (at least 3 characters)
errors.password: The password needs at least 8 characters
errors.terms: Accept the terms to create the account
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

home.title: Platform overview
home.description: How Housetel is doing: recurring revenue, hotels and the marketplace.
home.mrrHint: Active and past-due subscriptions; yearly plans count their price divided by 12.
home.revenueText: Invoiced subscriptions and accrued marketplace commissions, before VAT.
home.gmvText: Value of confirmed marketplace bookings, by the month they were made.
home.attentionEmpty: All good: no organization is past due, suspended or about to end its trial.

reason.suspended: Suspended: can't use Housetel until it pays
reason.pastDue: Payment due: the charge is being retried
reason.simulatedFailure: Has the failed-charge simulation turned on

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.description: Every Housetel customer with its plan, status, size and revenue.
orgs.emptyText: Try another status, plan or search.

org.subtitle: {{legal}} · {{nit}} · customer since {{date}}
org.reactivateText: The organization works again right away. Unpaid invoices stay open and can be charged later.
org.suspendText: Its users can no longer use Housetel (only billing and team) and the owners get an email. It reactivates when they pay, or from here.
org.changePlanText: The change applies from the next invoice. As an admin you can assign any plan, even one smaller than their usage.
org.planTooSmall: That plan is smaller than their {{units}} units: they'll see the limit notice, but nothing is blocked.
org.extendText: The trial ends on {{date}}. Days are added from that date, or from today if it already ended.
org.daysHint: Between 1 and 90. Invoices issued when the trial ended are voided.
org.cancelsAtEnd: Ends at the end of the period
org.noSubscription: This organization has no subscription yet: it's created when a member opens Plan & billing.
org.simulateFailureHint: For demos: this organization's simulated charges are declined while it's on.
org.failureOff: This organization's charges are approved again.
org.endTrialWithCard: Its first period starts today and the first invoice is charged to the card on file.
org.endTrialNoCard: Its first period starts today. There's no card on file: the invoice stays open and the organization moves to payment due.
org.trialEndedPaid: Trial ended: {{name}} paid its first invoice and is active.
org.trialEndedDue: Trial ended: {{name}} has its first invoice due.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Every plan includes every feature; they only differ by size. Prices in COP, before VAT.
plans.deleteText: Only a plan without subscriptions can be deleted. If it has any, deactivate it so nobody else picks it.
plans.formHint: Price changes apply to the next invoices of everyone on this plan.
plans.codeHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (e.g. pro-plus).
plans.codeLocked: The code can't change once created.
plans.activeHint: Inactive plans don't show up at signup or when changing plans.

errors.code: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (2 to 40 characters)
errors.count: Enter a number above 0 or leave it empty

invoices.noCard: The organization has no card on file.
invoices.markPaidText: Records a {{amount}} payment from {{org}} received outside Housetel (bank transfer, deposit). If it was the last unpaid invoice, the organization is reactivated.
invoices.voidText: The invoice is no longer charged and this can't be undone. The commissions it included go back to open for a new settlement.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Invoices of every organization, the daily billing cycle and the account Housetel charges with.
billing.runCycleText: Same as the daily 03:00 run: converts expired trials, invoices renewals, charges, retries and suspends for non-payment.
billing.cycleFailed: The billing cycle failed; check the details in Automations.
billing.accountText: Housetel charges plans and commissions with its own Wompi account, separate from each hotel's. In simulated mode charges approve on their own, except for organizations with the failure simulation on.
billing.modeReal: Live charging with Wompi turned on.
billing.realHint: Saved cards are charged through Wompi and manual payments go to Wompi's checkout.
billing.simulatedHint: No charge leaves Housetel: meant for demos and testing.
billing.missingCredentials: Wompi credentials are missing from the environment: charges will fail until they're set.
billing.envHint: They're server environment variables (.env) and are never shown here.
billing.webhook: Events URL for the Wompi dashboard

commissions.title: Commissions
commissions.description: What each hotel owes Housetel for marketplace bookings, and the monthly settlement.
commissions.emptyText: Commissions appear when a confirmed booking comes in through the marketplace.
commissions.settlementsText: On the 1st of each month, last month's commissions are settled per organization and invoiced with VAT.
commissions.settleText: Groups the chosen month's pending commissions per organization, creates their invoice with VAT and charges it. A month already settled isn't repeated.
